responsibility: Provides host-CPU autodetection for the Cranelift backend’s `target_cpu=native` path. This vendored helper creates a Cranelift ISA builder for the current machine and, when requested, enables architecture-specific native feature flags discovered at runtime on supported hosts such as x86_64, AArch64, s390x, and riscv64, so the crate’s ISA-construction logic can target the local machine correctly.
